basic_details.short_information: One post of EVP & Head- Market Risk, ALM & Enterprise Risk (UR), in the grade of Executive Vice President, is open at the National Bank for Financing Infrastructure and Development (NaBFID) on a fixed-term (contract) basis. Indian citizens can send their CV with a passport sized photograph by email to [email protected] from 3 November 2026. Applications must be received on or before 24 November 2026 by 06:00 pm IST.

Of these, 5 years should be in risk management function (in RBI regulated entity). Of these 5 years, 2 years should be at senior management level. Experience in the infrastructure domain will be preferred. | The notice invites applications from Indian Citizens. | Remuneration will be offered based on qualifications, experience, suitability, last drawn salary and market benchmark, and shall not be a limiting factor for suitable candidates. No fixed amount is printed in the notice. Contractual engagement will be for a period of 5 years, which may be renewed for additional terms at the discretion of the Bank. Location of position: Mumbai. Selected candidates may be posted in the Bank's establishment in Mumbai/New Delhi/Anywhere in India, as per the Bank's discretion and requirement. Engagement of the selected candidate is subject to being declared medically fit as per the requirement of the Bank. | Candidates should check the detailed role description linked in the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

selection_process: Applications will be screened and shortlisted on the basis of eligibility and relevant experience
and the requisite number of shortlisted candidates will be called for interview.

Screening and shortlisting: based on eligibility and relevant experience. Merely satisfying the eligibility norms does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. Additional assessment: shortlisted candidates may undergo psychometric tests and/or assessment centre and/or any other selection method deemed suitable by NaBFID
in addition to the personal interview. Personal Interview: conducted by a committee constituted for this purpose. Final selection: made on the basis of eligibility
qualification and performance during the Personal Interview. Selection is solely at the discretion of NaBFID's Selection Committee
and its decision will be final.
The intimation or call letter for interview will be sent by email or uploaded to the Bank's website. No hard copy of the interview letter will be shared.
important_instructions: Candidates appearing for the interview process will be reimbursed for economy class airfare expenses. Government, quasi-government, PSU, nationalised bank and financial institution employees who fail to submit the NOC at interview may not be considered, and travelling expenses otherwise admissible will not be paid. Intimations will be sent by email only to the email ID and mobile number provided; the Bank is not responsible if they do not reach candidates due to a change in contact details, technical fault or otherwise. The Bank may conduct independent verification, including police records, and reserves the right to deny the engagement depending on such disclosures or verification. If a candidate does not fulfil the eligibility norms or has furnished false information or suppressed material facts, the candidature will be cancelled; if detected after appointment, services are liable to be terminated without notice. NaBFID reserves the right to amend, rescind or re-advertise the position at any time without assigning any reasons. Decisions of the Bank on eligibility, interviews, other tests and selection are final; no representation or correspondence will be entertained. Any legal proceedings can be instituted only in Mumbai, and courts, tribunals and forums at Mumbai have sole and exclusive jurisdiction. All changes, updates and corrigenda will be hosted only on the careers page of the Bank's website (nabfid.org/careers); no separate intimation will be issued.

content_sections.heading: About NaBFID
content_sections.text: The National Bank for Financing Infrastructure and Development (NaBFID) has been set up under an Act of Parliament, the NaBFID Act, 2021, as the principal entity for infrastructure financing in the country. It is regulated and supervised as an All-India Financial Institution (AIFI) by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). According to the notice, NaBFID supports infrastructure funding by developing innovative financing instruments, bond and derivatives markets, and data-driven risk management.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: NaBFID accepts applications for this post only by email. The notice states that no other mode of application will be accepted and hard copies are not to be sent. Visit the link given against the job position for the detailed role description. Prepare your CV, including a passport sized photograph. Send the CV by email to [email protected] . Write the subject line strictly as "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF <Job Code>". The job code printed for this post is NABFID/EVP/16. Make sure the email is received on or before 24 November 2026 by 06:00 pm IST. Candidates should have a valid email ID and keep it active till the declaration of result, as call letters and interview advice will be sent by email.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Graduate /Postgraduate in any discipline from a recognized University / Institution or a Chartered Account. Preferred: Certification in Financial Risk Management from Global Association of Risk Professionals (GARP) OR Professional Risk Management Certification from PRIMA Institute. Minimum 20 years of experience in financial sector. Of these, 5 years should be in risk management function (in RBI regulated entity). Of these 5 years, 2 years should be at senior management level. Experience in the infrastructure domain will be preferred. The notice invites applications from Indian Citizens. Remuneration will be offered based on qualifications, experience, suitability, last drawn salary and market benchmark, and shall not be a limiting factor for suitable candidates. No fixed amount is printed in the notice. Contractual engagement will be for a period of 5 years, which may be renewed for additional terms at the discretion of the Bank. Location of position: Mumbai. Selected candidates may be posted in the Bank's establishment in Mumbai/New Delhi/Anywhere in India, as per the Bank's discretion and requirement. Engagement of the selected candidate is subject to being declared medically fit as per the requirement of the Bank. Candidates should check the detailed role description linked in the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: NaBFID Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Responsible for developing and implementing NaBFID's enterprise-wide risk framework. Ensuring that the Bank's portfolio is built within the defined risk parameters. Building appropriate mechanisms to measure risk. Providing advice and structuring risk mitigation into the business operations at NaBFID. A detailed role description is available as a separate document on the NaBFID website, linked from the notice.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: CV including a passport sized photograph (with the email application). No Objection Certificate from the employer at the time of interview, for candidates serving in Govt./Quasi Govt. offices, Public Sector undertakings including Nationalised Banks and Financial Institutions. Details of criminal case(s) pending, if any, at the time of interview. Proper relieving letters from the employer at the time of taking up the appointment, in case of selection.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications will be screened and shortlisted on the basis of eligibility and relevant experience, and the requisite number of shortlisted candidates will be called for interview. Screening and shortlisting: based on eligibility and relevant experience. Merely satisfying the eligibility norms does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. Additional assessment: shortlisted candidates may undergo psychometric tests and/or assessment centre and/or any other selection method deemed suitable by NaBFID, in addition to the personal interview. Personal Interview: conducted by a committee constituted for this purpose. Final selection: made on the basis of eligibility, experience, qualification and performance during the Personal Interview. Selection is solely at the discretion of NaBFID's Selection Committee, and its decision will be final. The intimation or call letter for interview will be sent by email or uploaded to the Bank's website. No hard copy of the interview letter will be shared.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NaBFID Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy (UR) for the post of EVP & Head- Market Risk, ALM & Enterprise Risk under Advertisement No. NaBFID/REC/EVP/2026-27/02.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NaBFID EVP post?
faq.answer: Applications must be received by email on or before 24 November 2026 by 06:00 pm IST.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for NaBFID EVP & Head- Market Risk, ALM & Enterprise Risk?
faq.answer: Graduate /Postgraduate in any discipline from a recognized University / Institution or a Chartered Account, with minimum 20 years of experience in financial sector, including 5 years in risk management function (in RBI regulated entity), of which 2 years at senior management level.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the NaBFID EVP post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 55 years and below as on the date of advertisement, and the maximum age shall not exceed 55 years even after applying all relaxations.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for NaBFID EVP & Head- Market Risk, ALM & Enterprise Risk?
faq.answer: Remuneration will be offered based on qualifications, experience, suitability, last drawn salary and market benchmark, and shall not be a limiting factor for suitable candidates.

faq.question: Q6. How to apply for NaBFID Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Indian citizens should email their CV, including a passport sized photograph, to [email protected]; hard copies are not to be sent.

faq.question: Q7. What should be the email subject line for the NaBFID EVP application?
faq.answer: The subject line should strictly be "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF <Job Code>", and the job code printed for this post is NABFID/EVP/16.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the NaBFID EVP post?
faq.answer: Applications are screened and shortlisted on eligibility and relevant experience, followed by a personal interview by a committee; shortlisted candidates may also undergo psychometric tests and/or an assessment centre.

faq.question: Q9. Is the NaBFID EVP post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is contractual for a period of 5 years, which may be renewed for additional terms at the discretion of the Bank.

faq.question: Q10. Will NaBFID pay travel expenses for the interview?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates appearing for the interview process will be reimbursed for economy class airfare expenses, subject to the NOC condition for serving government and PSU employees.
